notes: The first name is written by the text as the chain's opening transmitter, the same name the work's compiler carries; the tool's compiler head may duplicate it, so check against the work's opening before applying
«من كتابه» is a source phrase and «القاضي بلخ», «الحافظ» are epithets, left out; «وكانت عمتي» (twice) and «وكان رضيعا» are remarks on relations, not links
«عن خالها عبد الله بن منصور» : the maternal-uncle relation plus a name is one link, the surface the name alone (rule 7)

«سألت جعفر ... فقال حدثني أبي، عن أبيه» : the asked Imam answers and his chain goes on (rule 5); Ja'far is an imam_in_text link, then two bare relations, the last being the source of the narrated events
